reading.notes: Vinyl label for Side D; no actual tracklist is printed. It shows a large stylized 'F' logo over a background of faint, partially cropped decorative text fragments: 'FEELS LIK…', '…URGENT' (partial), '…KNOW WHAT LOVE I…', '…OT BLOODE…', '…KE BOX HE…'. These fragments look like song titles used as design and are not a sequenced tracklist. The rim text includes: 'Unauthorized copying, reproduction, hiring, lending, public performance and broadcasting prohibited. Made in Germany by optimal media GmbH. GEMA/BIEM', 'LC 45916' (partly legible), '℗&© 2025 Trooper Productions, Inc. under exclusive license to earMUSIC, a label of Edel Music & Entertainment GmbH. All rights reserved.' A catalogue-like number on the rim (starting '0…') is illegible.
